text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Air Shakur, who 
hasn't been in the best shape lately.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A 'divine blessing' ain't logical, so I 
wasn't countin' on it from the start 
anyway, but still...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dotou's always fussing over me. Saying 
stuff like, "Why not just give it a try?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If I do what I gotta do, maybe they'll 
settle down a bit. Sheesh, worrying over 
nothing."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you think you can get me in top shape, 
just try it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...If things got better just from this, 
life'd be easy. In the end, the only one 
who can change you is yourself—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the headphones I lost last 
month suddenly turned up in my room...
choice_data_list: Guess it brought you good luck, huh?

text_block_list.text:
"Although she didn't believe in divine 
blessings, a string of good fortune 
followed, and she eventually got back into 
top shape."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, it just had to start pouring. 
Right after visiting the shrine, too. Talk 
about bad luck.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the only one I can rely on is 
myself... Should've just stayed in my room 
typing code.

Air Shakur got drenched, and she had a 
hard time getting back into top condition 
after that.
